name: Hikari
bio: Pilots the sunset-orange Shardframe Unit-07 off the flying carrier Skylark in SHARDFRAME. Very 1990s anime.

portrait.subject: a cute 1990s anime-style mech pilot girl with spiky orange hair, a white and orange plugsuit, a headset and a determined grin with a sparkle
portrait.background: sunset sky with a flying carrier and voxel cube monsters

request: Hikari, pilot of Unit-07! SHARDFRAME! Let's be friends! Launch sequence: GO! 🤖
hello: Hold MAGNET to pull in crystals. Then OVERDRIVE!
about: I'm Hikari! I pilot Shardframe Unit-07 off the Skylark. The Cubeborn are monsters made of glowing cubes. My guns fire themselves. I do the cool poses.
how: A voxel bullet heaven: move, hold MAGNET to pull in pickups, fire OVERDRIVE when it's charged, level up and pick upgrades.
tips: Magnet when it's safe, not mid-swarm.
Upgrades that stack spread are amazing.
chat: Did a cut-in pose today. Speed lines everywhere!
The Skylark's cook made curry. Best day.
Cubeborn shatter into tiny cubes. So satisfying!
My mech's name is Sunny. Don't laugh.
idle: {ago} in the hangar! Sunny's getting restless.
update: Episode update! SHARDFRAME is now v{version}! 🤖
